item.title: Think tank cites Ocala as example of failing government-run internet
item.description: A free-market think tank is pointing to Ocala as a primary example of why Florida municipalities should reconsider entering the internet business, arguing that government-owned broadband networks saddle taxpayers with debt and underperform compared to private competitors. item.title: My Marion neighborhood is being invaded by bicyclists
item.description: "I too have written to the county commissioners via email; with no response. As a tax paying citizen of Marion County and have been since 1997, I expect some representation. We live in northwest Marion County. It is a rural area; not so quiet anymore. We have a very narrow County Road that they just resurfaced with no bike lanes.
